items.root_cause: Prior system used limited static symbol list (20 priority stocks); lacked dynamic discovery of complete official F&O universe
items.last_verification: VERIFIED: Dynamically discovered all 219 active stock option underlyings with 108,477 contracts across NSE and BSE. Passed CHK-0201 through CHK-0550.

items.issue: Separate Multibagger Cash Equity Universe: official NSE/BSE cash equities partitioned from options with truthful fundamental contracts

items.last_verification: VERIFIED: Sync engine in market_coverage_master.py validates official CDN URLs with SHA-256 digest (35.4 MB, 127k+ active rows). Passed CHK-0001 through CHK-0050.

items.issue: Rate Limiting & Bounded Pacing: respect Dhan API request pacing limits without quota exhaustion
